# World Dugong Day Celebration
> An event dedicated to raising awareness and celebrating the conservation of Dugongs.

## Website
- Official Event Site: https://dugongdayceleb.vercel.app/

## Registration
- Audience Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/dugongday

## Event Information
- **Event Name:** World Dugong Day Celebration
- **Date:** May 28, 2026
- **Audience:** Open to everyone interested in marine conservation.
- **Goal:** To register participants, spread awareness, and provide access to event programs.
